mandatory_review_items.SR04: Evaluate whether the minimum successor semantic scope correctly includes the three unresolved representation-policy assertions and does not silently strengthen, weaken, or replace their semantics.

mandatory_review_items.SR06: Evaluate the semantic-accounting boundary and whether unit accountability is correctly distinguished from actual semantic encoding and exact reverse reconstruction.
mandatory_review_items.SR07: Evaluate backward compatibility and the proposed minimum future governance sequence, including immutability of frozen zlib/libpcap and historical Schema-V1/Schema-V2 artifacts.
mandatory_review_items.SR08: Evaluate whether the bounded conclusion SCHEMA_SUCCESSOR_REQUIRED is supported under the existing exact V4 losslessness/admissibility contract, without overclaiming general Schema-V2 invalidity or abstract information-theoretic impossibility.
